# What redundancy pay, notice and leave are owed on this termination?

> Free Australian redundancy pay calculator: enter pay, start and end dates, age and employer size to see NES redundancy weeks, notice pay and accrued leave. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/au-redundancy-pay-calculator/)
